from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
program_dir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485492/attempts/9f509ca37a0f4b279e3de00a5074f14c/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != background]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in points)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
        if out[r0][c] == background:
            out[r0][c] = 2
        if out[r1][c] == background:
            out[r1][c] = 2
    for r in range(r0 + 1, r1):
        if out[r][c0] == background:
            out[r][c0] = 2
        if out[r][c1] == background:
            out[r][c1] = 2
    return out
'''
task_file.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(task_file), 'exec'), globals())
